topic: Entity-attribute-value models for sparse clinical data
title: Pivoting an entity-attribute-value record
instructions:
## One row per observation

OpenMRS-style records store every observation as a row: **obs** (encounter_id, concept, value_num, value_text). A visit with a temperature, a weight and a diagnosis is three rows. Clinicians, though, want one row per visit.

Tables: **patients** (id, name), **encounters** (id, patient_id, visit_date), **obs** as above. Concepts used: `TEMP` (°C, numeric), `WEIGHT` (kg, numeric), `DIAGNOSIS` (text). Not every visit has every observation.

## Do this

Return one row per encounter: `id`, `name`, `visit_date`, `temperature`, `weight`, `diagnosis` (NULL where not recorded), ordered by visit_date then id.

The pattern is conditional aggregation: `MAX(CASE WHEN o.concept = 'TEMP' THEN o.value_num END) AS temperature`, grouped by encounter.

initialState.sql:
SELECT e.id, p.name, e.visit_date
FROM encounters e
JOIN patients p ON p.id = e.patient_id

hints: `LEFT JOIN obs o ON o.encounter_id = e.id` brings in the observations (LEFT, in case a visit has none).
One `MAX(CASE WHEN o.concept = ... THEN ... END)` per column turns rows into columns.
`GROUP BY e.id, p.name, e.visit_date ORDER BY e.visit_date, e.id`.

checks.label: One row per encounter with temperature, weight and diagnosis
checks.expectedQuery: SELECT e.id, p.name, e.visit_date, MAX(CASE WHEN o.concept = 'TEMP' THEN o.value_num END) AS temperature, MAX(CASE WHEN o.concept = 'WEIGHT' THEN o.value_num END) AS weight, MAX(CASE WHEN o.concept = 'DIAGNOSIS' THEN o.value_text END) AS diagnosis FROM encounters e JOIN patients p ON p.id = e.patient_id LEFT JOIN obs o ON o.encounter_id = e.id GROUP BY e.id, p.name, e.visit_date ORDER BY e.visit_date, e.id

checks.label: It pivots with conditional aggregation
checks.message: Use MAX(CASE WHEN concept = ... THEN value END) to turn observation rows into columns.

realityNote: OpenMRS, Bahmni and most research databases (i2b2, OMOP) are entity-attribute-value underneath; every flowsheet and report view is a pivot like this one.
